verdict.rationale: Retry safety is a fair question for a transactional email send API, so the axis applies. The pack documents the v3 Mail Send endpoint, SMTP, sandbox mode, and webhooks, but nothing about idempotency keys or duplicate-suppression semantics on retries. Sandbox mode only validates a request without delivering it; it is a dry-run feature and does not prevent double-sends after a network timeout.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can retry a failed send safely — idempotency keys or documented duplicate-suppression semantics guarantee a network timeout never double-sends a receipt
